en: Identify an asset that may be impaired
Explain the different measurements of the recoverable amount
Explain the recognition of an impairment loss
Discuss the reversal of an impairment loss
Discuss the disclosure for impairment
ms: Kenal pasti aset yang mungkin rosot nilai
Terangkan pengukuran berbeza amaun boleh pulih

en: **Impairment** = a **loss or reduction in the economic benefits** that can be derived from an asset.
An asset is **impaired** when its **carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount** (the amount to be recovered through **use or sale**).
**MFRS 136 Impairment of Assets** (based on IAS 36) sets the procedures to ensure assets are carried at **no more than their recoverable amount**.
When impaired, the entity recognises an **impairment loss**.
ms: **Rosot nilai** = **kerugian atau pengurangan manfaat ekonomi** yang boleh diperoleh daripada aset.
Aset **rosot nilai** bila **amaun dibawanya melebihi amaun boleh pulih** (amaun yang akan dipulihkan melalui **penggunaan atau jualan**).
**MFRS 136 Rosot Nilai Aset** (berasaskan IAS 36) menetapkan prosedur supaya aset dibawa pada **tidak lebih daripada amaun boleh pulih**.
Bila rosot nilai, entiti mengiktiraf **kerugian rosot nilai**.

blocks.en: The slides say the standard ensures assets are carried "at a value less than" the recoverable amount and that a carrying amount larger than recoverable "suggests an indication" of impairment. The correct statements are: carried at no MORE than recoverable amount; and carrying amount > recoverable amount IS impairment (an "indication" is only the trigger to test).
blocks.ms: Slide kata piawaian memastikan aset dibawa "pada nilai kurang daripada" amaun boleh pulih dan amaun dibawa lebih besar "mencadangkan petunjuk" rosot nilai. Pernyataan betul: dibawa pada TIDAK LEBIH daripada amaun boleh pulih; dan amaun dibawa > amaun boleh pulih ADALAH rosot nilai ("petunjuk" hanya pencetus untuk menguji).

blocks.en: Memory hook: Impaired when Carrying amount > Recoverable amount. Loss = CA − RA.
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: Rosot nilai bila Amaun dibawa > Amaun boleh pulih. Kerugian = CA − RA.

big.en: Impairment loss = Carrying amount − Recoverable amount (when CA > RA). Recoverable amount = the HIGHER of FVLCD and VIU.
big.ms: Kerugian rosot nilai = Amaun dibawa − Amaun boleh pulih (bila CA > RA). Amaun boleh pulih = yang LEBIH TINGGI antara FVLCD dan VIU.

en: MFRS 136 **does apply** to investments in **subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures** (impairment of the investment itself).
MFRS 136 also applies to assets at **revalued amount** (e.g. the revaluation model in MFRS 116); whether a revalued asset is impaired depends on how its fair value was determined.
ms: MFRS 136 **terpakai** kepada pelaburan dalam **subsidiari, syarikat bersekutu dan usaha sama** (rosot nilai pelaburan itu sendiri).
MFRS 136 juga terpakai kepada aset pada **amaun dinilai semula** (cth model penilaian semula MFRS 116); sama ada aset dinilai semula rosot nilai bergantung bagaimana nilai saksamanya ditentukan.

en: Assess **at the end of each reporting period** whether there is **any indication** that an asset may be impaired.
The list of indicators is **not exhaustive**. Look at **external** and **internal** sources of information.
If there is an indication, **estimate the recoverable amount**.
Assessment is normally done for an **individual asset** (machinery, equipment, property).
ms: Nilai **pada akhir setiap tempoh pelaporan** sama ada ada **sebarang petunjuk** aset mungkin rosot nilai.
Senarai petunjuk **tidak lengkap**. Lihat sumber maklumat **luaran** dan **dalaman**.
Jika ada petunjuk, **anggar amaun boleh pulih**.
Penilaian biasanya dibuat untuk **aset individu** (jentera, peralatan, hartanah).

en: External sources
Internal sources
Decline in the asset's market value during the year
Evidence of obsolescence or physical damage (e.g. natural disaster)
ms: Kejatuhan nilai pasaran aset sepanjang tahun
Bukti keusangan atau kerosakan fizikal (cth bencana alam)

en: Adverse change in technological, market, economic or legal environment
Adverse change in the use of the asset
ms: Perubahan buruk dalam persekitaran teknologi, pasaran, ekonomi atau undang-undang

en: Increase in market interest rates
Worse-than-expected economic performance of the asset
ms: Prestasi ekonomi aset lebih teruk daripada dijangka

en: Carrying amount of net assets exceeds market capitalisation
ms: Amaun dibawa aset bersih melebihi permodalan pasaran

blocks.en: Exam answer: always say "external" and "internal" and give at least two examples of each.
blocks.ms: Jawapan exam: sentiasa sebut "luaran" dan "dalaman" dan beri sekurang-kurangnya dua contoh setiap satu.

blocks.en: Normally an impairment test is done **only when there is an indication**. But these must be tested **every year, even without an indication**:
blocks.ms: Biasanya ujian rosot nilai dibuat **hanya bila ada petunjuk**. Tetapi ini mesti diuji **setiap tahun, walaupun tiada petunjuk**:

en: An **intangible asset with an indefinite useful life**.
An **intangible asset not yet available for use**.
**Goodwill** acquired in a business combination.
The annual test can be done **at any time in the year**, provided it is done **at the same time every year**.
Different intangibles may be tested at **different times**; an intangible **first recognised in the current period** must be tested **before the end of that period**.
When an asset shows an indication of impairment, its **useful life, depreciation method or residual value** may also need to be reviewed and adjusted.
ms: Ujian tahunan boleh dibuat **pada bila-bila masa dalam tahun**, asalkan dibuat **pada masa sama setiap tahun**.
Aset tak ketara berbeza boleh diuji pada **masa berbeza**; aset tak ketara **diiktiraf pertama kali dalam tempoh semasa** mesti diuji **sebelum akhir tempoh itu**.
Bila aset ada petunjuk rosot nilai, **hayat berguna, kaedah susut nilai atau nilai sisa**nya juga mungkin perlu disemak dan dilaraskan.

blocks.en: The slide says "unlike the other assets, impairment review is made when there is presence of impairment" for goodwill and intangibles. That is garbled: the correct point is the opposite: they are tested annually REGARDLESS of indications.
blocks.ms: Slide kata "tidak seperti aset lain, semakan rosot nilai dibuat bila ada petunjuk" untuk muhibah dan aset tak ketara. Itu kabur: yang betul sebaliknya: ia diuji setiap tahun TANPA MENGIRA petunjuk.

en: Identify the **recoverable amount (RA)**.
If **CA > RA** → reduce the carrying amount to RA and recognise an **impairment loss**.
If **RA ≥ CA** → **no write-down**.
ms: Jika **CA > RA** → kurangkan amaun dibawa kepada RA dan iktiraf **kerugian rosot nilai**.

blocks.en: Recoverable amount = HIGHER of (Fair value less costs of disposal, FVLCD) and (Value in use, VIU)
blocks.ms: Amaun boleh pulih = YANG LEBIH TINGGI antara (Nilai saksama tolak kos pelupusan, FVLCD) dan (Nilai guna, VIU)

blocks.en: Fair value less costs of disposal (FVLCD)
blocks.ms: Nilai saksama tolak kos pelupusan (FVLCD)

en: The price from a **binding sale agreement** in an **arm's length transaction** between knowledgeable, willing parties, **less costs of disposal**.
Earlier called "fair value less costs to sell". **Fair value** is determined under **MFRS 13** (periods from 1 January 2013).
ms: Harga daripada **perjanjian jualan mengikat** dalam **transaksi arm's length** antara pihak berpengetahuan dan sanggup, **tolak kos pelupusan**.
Dahulu dipanggil "nilai saksama tolak kos jualan". **Nilai saksama** ditentukan di bawah **MFRS 13** (tempoh bermula 1 Januari 2013).

blocks.en: Value in use (VIU)
blocks.ms: Nilai guna (VIU)

en: **Present value of the future cash flows** expected from the asset, normally from its **cash-generating unit (CGU)**.
A **CGU** is the **smallest identifiable group of assets** that generates cash inflows **largely independent** of other assets or groups of assets.

Two inputs: **cash flow projections** (estimates of future cash flows, including variations in amount or timing) and the **discount rate** (reflects current market assessment of the **time value of money** and **asset-specific risks**, and the return investors would require).
ms: **Nilai kini aliran tunai masa depan** yang dijangka daripada aset, biasanya daripada **unit penjana tunai (CGU)**nya.
**CGU** ialah **kumpulan aset terkecil yang boleh dikenal pasti** yang menjana aliran tunai masuk **hampir bebas** daripada aset atau kumpulan aset lain.

Dua input: **unjuran aliran tunai** (anggaran aliran tunai masa depan, termasuk variasi amaun atau masa) dan **kadar diskaun** (mencerminkan penilaian pasaran semasa **nilai masa wang** dan **risiko khusus aset**, serta pulangan yang pelabur mahu).

blocks.en: Extra: if EITHER FVLCD or VIU is higher than the carrying amount, the asset is not impaired and you need not estimate the other. The discount rate used in VIU is a pre-tax rate.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: jika SALAH SATU FVLCD atau VIU lebih tinggi daripada amaun dibawa, aset tidak rosot nilai dan anda tak perlu anggar yang lain. Kadar diskaun dalam VIU ialah kadar sebelum cukai.

blocks.en: HMD Company built a property in 2015 for RM1.2 million. Its carrying amount at 31 December 2017 (after revaluation) was RM1.8 million. At 31 December 2019: fair value less costs of disposal RM1 million; value in use RM800,000.
blocks.ms: HMD Company membina hartanah pada 2015 dengan kos RM1.2 juta. Amaun dibawa pada 31 Disember 2017 (selepas penilaian semula) ialah RM1.8 juta. Pada 31 Disember 2019: nilai saksama tolak kos pelupusan RM1 juta; nilai guna RM800,000.

blocks.en: RA = higher of 1,000,000 and 800,000 = RM1,000,000. CA 1,800,000 > RA → impairment loss = RM800,000.
blocks.ms: RA = lebih tinggi antara 1,000,000 dan 800,000 = RM1,000,000. CA 1,800,000 > RA → kerugian rosot nilai = RM800,000.

blocks.en: For a revalued asset the loss first reduces the revaluation surplus (OCI): RM600,000. Only the excess, RM200,000, goes to profit or loss (shown as "Impairment loss (200,000)" in the profit or loss extract).
blocks.ms: Bagi aset dinilai semula kerugian mula-mula mengurangkan lebihan penilaian semula (OCI): RM600,000. Hanya lebihan, RM200,000, ke untung atau rugi (ditunjuk sebagai "Kerugian rosot nilai (200,000)" dalam petikan untung atau rugi).

blocks.en: The slide uses the 7% borrowing cost as the discount rate. The standard asks for a pre-tax rate reflecting the market's assessment of time value and the asset's specific risks. After impairment, depreciate the new carrying amount over the remaining life.
blocks.ms: Slide guna kos pinjaman 7% sebagai kadar diskaun. Piawaian meminta kadar sebelum cukai yang mencerminkan penilaian pasaran nilai masa dan risiko khusus aset. Selepas rosot nilai, susutnilaikan amaun dibawa baharu sepanjang baki hayat.

en: **Goodwill** represents future benefits from assets that cannot be identified and recognised separately. It is **tested for impairment at least annually**, by testing the **CGU** to which it is allocated.
From the **acquisition date**, goodwill is **allocated to each of the acquirer's CGUs (or groups)** expected to benefit from the combination.
Each unit to which goodwill is allocated must be the **lowest level at which goodwill is monitored for internal management** and **not larger than an operating segment** (MFRS 8) before aggregation.
Compare the **carrying amount of the unit, including goodwill**, with the **recoverable amount of the unit**: if RA > CA no goodwill impairment; if CA > RA recognise an impairment loss.

A **previous period's RA calculation may be reused** only if the unit's assets and liabilities have not changed significantly, the last RA exceeded the carrying amount by a wide margin, and, given current events, it is remote that the current RA is below the carrying amount.
ms: **Muhibah** mewakili manfaat masa depan daripada aset yang tidak boleh dikenal pasti dan diiktiraf berasingan. Ia **diuji rosot nilai sekurang-kurangnya setahun sekali**, dengan menguji **CGU** tempat ia diperuntukkan.
Dari **tarikh perolehan**, muhibah **diperuntukkan kepada setiap CGU (atau kumpulan) pemerolehan** yang dijangka mendapat manfaat daripada penggabungan.
Setiap unit yang diperuntukkan muhibah mesti **tahap terendah muhibah dipantau untuk pengurusan dalaman** dan **tidak lebih besar daripada segmen operasi** (MFRS 8) sebelum pengagregatan.
Banding **amaun dibawa unit, termasuk muhibah**, dengan **amaun boleh pulih unit**: jika RA > CA tiada rosot nilai muhibah; jika CA > RA iktiraf kerugian rosot nilai.

**Pengiraan RA tempoh lalu boleh digunakan semula** hanya jika aset dan liabiliti unit tidak berubah ketara, RA terakhir melebihi amaun dibawa dengan jauh, dan, mengikut peristiwa semasa, amat jarang RA semasa di bawah amaun dibawa.

blocks.en: The slide cites "MFRS 138 para 90" for testing a CGU with goodwill; the correct reference is MFRS 136 para 90.
blocks.ms: Slide petik "MFRS 138 para 90" untuk menguji CGU dengan muhibah; rujukan betul ialah MFRS 136 para 90.

blocks.en: If the **unit's RA is below its carrying amount**, allocate the loss in this order:
blocks.ms: Jika **RA unit di bawah amaun dibawanya**, peruntukkan kerugian mengikut susunan ini:

en: First, reduce the carrying amount of **any goodwill** allocated to the unit.
Then reduce the **other assets** of the unit **pro rata** to their carrying amounts.
The reductions are **impairment losses on individual assets**, recognised in **profit or loss**.
ms: Pertama, kurangkan amaun dibawa **sebarang muhibah** yang diperuntukkan kepada unit.
Kemudian kurangkan **aset lain** unit **secara pro rata** mengikut amaun dibawanya.
Pengurangan ialah **kerugian rosot nilai pada aset individu**, diiktiraf dalam **untung atau rugi**.

blocks.en: Extra: no asset is written down below the highest of its FVLCD, its VIU (if determinable) and zero.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: tiada aset ditulis turun di bawah yang tertinggi antara FVLCD, VIU (jika boleh ditentukan) dan sifar.

blocks.en: IJ Corporation bought 100% of SP Limited in 2015 for RM500 million; SP's net assets had a fair value of RM400 million, so goodwill was RM100 million. SP is a CGU. At the end of 2018 SP's net assets have a book value of RM380 million and the CGU's recoverable amount is RM350 million.
blocks.ms: IJ Corporation membeli 100% SP Limited pada 2015 dengan RM500 juta; aset bersih SP bernilai saksama RM400 juta, jadi muhibah RM100 juta. SP ialah CGU. Pada akhir 2018 aset bersih SP bernilai buku RM380 juta dan amaun boleh pulih CGU ialah RM350 juta.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): a CGU has goodwill RM50, asset A RM300 and asset B RM200 (RM million). The CGU's recoverable amount is RM450.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): CGU ada muhibah RM50, aset A RM300 dan aset B RM200 (RM juta). Amaun boleh pulih CGU ialah RM450.

blocks.en: Total CA 550 − RA 450 = loss 100. Goodwill absorbs 50 (to 0). The remaining 50 is shared pro rata: A = 50 × 300/500 = 30; B = 50 × 200/500 = 20. After: A 270, B 180 (total 450).
blocks.ms: Jumlah CA 550 − RA 450 = kerugian 100. Muhibah menyerap 50 (kepada 0). Baki 50 dikongsi pro rata: A = 50 × 300/500 = 30; B = 50 × 200/500 = 20. Selepas: A 270, B 180 (jumlah 450).

en: At the **end of each reporting period** assess whether an impairment loss **may have decreased or no longer exists**. If so, estimate the **recoverable amount**.
The reversal is recognised in **profit or loss**, **unless it relates to a revalued asset** (then treated as a revaluation increase).
The reversal is **limited**: the carrying amount cannot rise above what it **would have been (net of depreciation) had no impairment loss been recognised**.
Extra: an impairment loss on **goodwill is never reversed**. For a CGU, a reversal is allocated pro rata to assets **other than goodwill**.
ms: Pada **akhir setiap tempoh pelaporan** nilai sama ada kerugian rosot nilai **mungkin telah berkurang atau tidak lagi wujud**. Jika ya, anggar **amaun boleh pulih**.
Pembalikan diiktiraf dalam **untung atau rugi**, **kecuali berkaitan aset dinilai semula** (kemudian dilayan sebagai kenaikan penilaian semula).
Pembalikan **dihadkan**: amaun dibawa tidak boleh naik melebihi apa yang **sepatutnya (bersih daripada susut nilai) jika tiada kerugian rosot nilai diiktiraf**.
Tambahan: kerugian rosot nilai **muhibah tidak pernah dibalikkan**. Bagi CGU, pembalikan diperuntukkan pro rata kepada aset **selain muhibah**.

blocks.en: Continuing HMD: at 31 December 2020 the recoverable amount of the property is RM1.5 million (carrying amount RM1 million after the 2019 impairment).
blocks.ms: Sambung HMD: pada 31 Disember 2020 amaun boleh pulih hartanah ialah RM1.5 juta (amaun dibawa RM1 juta selepas rosot nilai 2019).

blocks.en: Increase = 1,500,000 − 1,000,000 = 500,000. The reversal in profit or loss cannot exceed the earlier P/L charge of RM200,000; the other RM300,000 goes to the revaluation surplus.
blocks.ms: Kenaikan = 1,500,000 − 1,000,000 = 500,000. Pembalikan dalam untung atau rugi tidak boleh melebihi caj P/L terdahulu RM200,000; baki RM300,000 ke lebihan penilaian semula.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers, cost model): cost RM100,000, 5-year straight-line. At the end of year 2 (CA 60,000) RA is 40,000: loss 20,000. Depreciation then = 40,000 ÷ 3 = 13,333 a year. At the end of year 3 (CA 26,667) RA is 50,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri, model kos): kos RM100,000, garis lurus 5 tahun. Pada akhir tahun 2 (CA 60,000) RA ialah 40,000: kerugian 20,000. Susut nilai kemudian = 40,000 ÷ 3 = 13,333 setahun. Pada akhir tahun 3 (CA 26,667) RA ialah 50,000.

blocks.en: Ceiling: CA without impairment at end of year 3 = 100,000 − 3 × 20,000 = 40,000. Reversal = 40,000 − 26,667 = RM13,333 (not 50,000 − 26,667).
blocks.ms: Had: CA tanpa rosot nilai pada akhir tahun 3 = 100,000 − 3 × 20,000 = 40,000. Pembalikan = 40,000 − 26,667 = RM13,333 (bukan 50,000 − 26,667).

blocks.en: The slide says (slide 49) that "no reversal of an impairment is allowed". That applies to goodwill only; reversals are allowed for other assets (slide 56).
blocks.ms: Slide (slide 49) kata "tiada pembalikan rosot nilai dibenarkan". Itu hanya untuk muhibah; pembalikan dibenarkan untuk aset lain (slide 56).

q.en: When is an asset impaired?
q.ms: Bila aset rosot nilai?

a.en: When its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount.
a.ms: Bila amaun dibawanya melebihi amaun boleh pulih.

q.en: Impairment loss formula
q.ms: Formula kerugian rosot nilai

a.en: Carrying amount − recoverable amount.
a.ms: Amaun dibawa − amaun boleh pulih.

q.en: Is a financial asset tested under MFRS 136?
q.ms: Adakah aset kewangan diuji di bawah MFRS 136?

a.en: No: financial assets are under MFRS 9 (slides say MFRS 139).
a.ms: Tidak: aset kewangan di bawah MFRS 9 (slide kata MFRS 139).

q.en: Name four assets excluded from MFRS 136
q.ms: Namakan empat aset dikecualikan daripada MFRS 136

a.en: Inventories; deferred tax assets; employee benefit assets; investment property at FV; biological assets at FVLCTS; held for sale assets; financial assets.
a.ms: Inventori; aset cukai tertunda; aset faedah pekerja; hartanah pelaburan pada FV; aset biologi pada FVLCTS; aset dipegang untuk jual; aset kewangan.

q.en: Does MFRS 136 cover investments in subsidiaries/associates?
q.ms: Adakah MFRS 136 meliputi pelaburan dalam subsidiari/syarikat bersekutu?

a.en: Yes: impairment of the investment itself.
a.ms: Ya: rosot nilai pelaburan itu sendiri.

q.en: When to assess for impairment indications
q.ms: Bila menilai petunjuk rosot nilai

a.en: At the end of each reporting period.
a.ms: Pada akhir setiap tempoh pelaporan.

q.en: External indicators (4)
q.ms: Petunjuk luaran (4)

a.en: Market value decline; adverse technological/market/economic/legal change; higher market interest rates; net assets above market capitalisation.
a.ms: Nilai pasaran jatuh; perubahan buruk teknologi/pasaran/ekonomi/undang-undang; kadar faedah pasaran naik; aset bersih melebihi permodalan pasaran.

q.en: Internal indicators (3)
q.ms: Petunjuk dalaman (3)

a.en: Obsolescence or physical damage; adverse change in use; worse-than-expected performance.
a.ms: Keusangan atau kerosakan fizikal; perubahan buruk dalam penggunaan; prestasi lebih teruk daripada dijangka.

q.en: Which assets need an annual impairment test regardless of indications?
q.ms: Aset mana perlu ujian rosot nilai tahunan tanpa mengira petunjuk?

a.en: Indefinite-life intangibles; intangibles not yet available for use; goodwill.
a.ms: Aset tak ketara hayat tidak terhad; aset tak ketara belum sedia digunakan; muhibah.

a.en: Any time in the year, provided it is at the same time every year.

q.en: Recoverable amount definition
q.ms: Takrif amaun boleh pulih

a.en: The higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use.
a.ms: Yang lebih tinggi antara nilai saksama tolak kos pelupusan dan nilai guna.

q.en: FVLCD: what is it and which standard?
q.ms: FVLCD: apa dan piawaian mana?

a.en: Arm's length sale price less costs of disposal; fair value per MFRS 13.
a.ms: Harga jualan arm's length tolak kos pelupusan; nilai saksama menurut MFRS 13.

q.en: Value in use: what is it?
q.ms: Nilai guna: apa itu?

a.en: PV of future cash flows expected from the asset (or CGU).
a.ms: PV aliran tunai masa depan dijangka daripada aset (atau CGU).

q.en: What is a cash-generating unit?
q.ms: Apa itu unit penjana tunai?

a.en: The smallest identifiable group of assets generating cash inflows largely independent of other assets.
a.ms: Kumpulan aset terkecil boleh dikenal pasti yang menjana aliran tunai masuk hampir bebas daripada aset lain.

q.en: Two inputs to VIU
q.ms: Dua input VIU

a.en: Cash flow projections and the discount rate (time value of money and asset-specific risk).
a.ms: Unjuran aliran tunai dan kadar diskaun (nilai masa wang dan risiko khusus aset).

q.en: If FVLCD already exceeds carrying amount?
q.ms: Jika FVLCD sudah melebihi amaun dibawa?

a.en: No impairment; no need to compute VIU.
a.ms: Tiada rosot nilai; tak perlu kira VIU.

q.en: Impairment of a revalued asset: where does the loss go?
q.ms: Rosot nilai aset dinilai semula: kerugian ke mana?

a.en: First against the revaluation surplus (OCI); the excess to profit or loss.
a.ms: Mula-mula terhadap lebihan penilaian semula (OCI); lebihan ke untung atau rugi.

q.en: Goodwill impairment: how is it tested?
q.ms: Rosot nilai muhibah: bagaimana diuji?

a.en: Annually, by comparing the CGU's carrying amount (including goodwill) with its recoverable amount.
a.ms: Setiap tahun, dengan membanding amaun dibawa CGU (termasuk muhibah) dengan amaun boleh pulihnya.

q.en: Level of a CGU for goodwill
q.ms: Tahap CGU untuk muhibah

a.en: Lowest level goodwill is monitored internally; not larger than an operating segment.
a.ms: Tahap terendah muhibah dipantau dalaman; tidak lebih besar daripada segmen operasi.

q.en: Reusing last year's recoverable amount
q.ms: Guna semula amaun boleh pulih tahun lalu

a.en: Only if assets/liabilities unchanged, last RA exceeded CA by a wide margin, and a shortfall is remote.
a.ms: Hanya jika aset/liabiliti tidak berubah, RA lalu melebihi CA dengan jauh, dan kekurangan amat jarang.

q.en: Order of allocating a CGU impairment loss
q.ms: Susunan peruntukan kerugian rosot nilai CGU

a.en: 1) Goodwill first; 2) other assets pro rata to carrying amounts.
a.ms: 1) Muhibah dahulu; 2) aset lain pro rata mengikut amaun dibawa.

q.ms: Contoh IJ/SP

a.ms: CA 480 (muhibah 100 + aset bersih 380) vs RA 350 → kerugian 130: muhibah 100, aset 30.

q.en: Floor for write-down of an individual asset (extra)
q.ms: Had bawah tulis turun aset individu (tambahan)

a.en: Not below the highest of FVLCD, VIU and zero.
a.ms: Tidak di bawah yang tertinggi antara FVLCD, VIU dan sifar.

q.en: Where is a reversal recognised?
q.ms: Pembalikan diiktiraf di mana?

a.en: Profit or loss, unless it relates to a revalued asset (treated as a revaluation increase).
a.ms: Untung atau rugi, kecuali berkaitan aset dinilai semula (dilayan sebagai kenaikan penilaian semula).

q.ms: Had pembalikan

a.en: Carrying amount cannot exceed what it would have been (net of depreciation) without impairment.
a.ms: Amaun dibawa tidak boleh melebihi apa yang sepatutnya (bersih susut nilai) tanpa rosot nilai.

q.en: Can goodwill impairment be reversed?
q.ms: Bolehkah rosot nilai muhibah dibalikkan?

a.en: Never.
a.ms: Tidak sekali-kali.

a.en: Losses and reversals (P/L and OCI) per class and line item; per segment; events and circumstances and amount of each material loss/reversal.
a.ms: Kerugian dan pembalikan (P/L dan OCI) setiap kelas dan baris item; setiap segmen; peristiwa dan keadaan serta amaun setiap kerugian/pembalikan material.

en: Recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD and VIU (1)
